save_model_proto: save a Caffe2 model's net and init protobuf files to disk for later inspection
get_flops_params: compute and log the total FLOPs and parameter count of a Caffe2 model network
check_nan_losses: check all loss blobs across devices for NaN values and exit if any are found
print_net: print a summary of a Caffe2 model's forward pass layers, inputs, outputs, and shapes
get_gpu_stats: query nvidia-smi and return the used GPU memory as a string
